snapshot.text: Finnair, the Finnish network carrier, ended FY2024 with revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{revenue@FY2024}}, but earnings fell as industrial action in Finland led to the cancellation of a large number of flights in the early and late parts of the year.

The EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, and net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}} despite lower net debt of {{net_debt@FY2024}}.

The point to watch is leverage against the network peers: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2024}} is above the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}} and the weakest of the group ({{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

credit_metrics.text: EBITDA fell by {{ebitda.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda@FY2024}} on revenue up {{revenue.change@FY2024}}, and operating profit declined by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}}.

Total debt was reduced by {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}} and net debt by {{net_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{net_debt@FY2024}}, yet gross leverage rose by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} as EBITDA fell.

Interest coverage improved by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}, while FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}} and FFO to debt was broadly unchanged at {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}}.

Free cash flow rose by {{fcf.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf@FY2024}}, lifting FCF to debt by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}}, helped by capex intensity easing by {{capex_intensity.change@FY2024}} to {{capex_intensity@FY2024}}.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, while the fleet was broadly unchanged at {{fleet@FY2024}} aircraft, with a new A350 delivered and leased A350 and A321 aircraft purchased during the year.
The fuel share of costs fell by {{fuel_share_of_costs.change@FY2024}} to {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2024}}, above the peer median of {{fuel_share_of_costs.peer_median@FY2024}}.
The fleet averaged {{fleet_age@FY2023}} in age in FY2023.

liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity to revenue declined by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}.
Total liquidity was {{liquidity@FY2024}}, including {{undrawn_facilities@FY2024}} of undrawn committed facilities under a new secured revolving credit facility agreed in April and unused at year-end.

Advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, with contract liabilities up {{contract_liabilities.change@FY2024}} to {{contract_liabilities@FY2024}}, so a larger share of cash is customers' prepayments.
Funding was refinanced during the year, with a new unsecured senior bond issued to repay the old one, and S&P assigned Finnair an issuer credit rating with a stable outlook.

peer_positioning.text: Finnair's EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}} puts it in the middle of the network group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2024}}), and FCF to debt of {{fcf_to_debt@FY2024}} also sits in the middle of the group.

Leverage is the weakest part of the profile: net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2024}} is above the peer median of {{net_leverage.peer_median@FY2024}} and ranks {{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}, and gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2024}} is also the highest of the group ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

Coverage and cash generation lag the group: interest coverage of {{interest_coverage@FY2024}} is below the peer median of {{interest_coverage.peer_median@FY2024}} and ranks {{interest_coverage.peer_rank@FY2024}}, and FFO to debt of {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}} is also the weakest ({{ffo_to_debt.peer_rank@FY2024}}).

watch_items.text: Leverage: net leverage rose by {{net_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{net_leverage@FY2024}} and gross leverage by {{gross_leverage.change@FY2024}} to {{gross_leverage@FY2024}}, both above the peer median, as EBITDA fell.

Earnings: the EBITDA margin narrowed by {{ebitda_margin.change@FY2024}} to {{ebitda_margin@FY2024}}, with industrial action in Finland leading to the cancellation of a large number of flights in the early and late parts of the year.
Cash generation: FFO fell by {{ffo.change@FY2024}} to {{ffo@FY2024}}, leaving FFO to debt at {{ffo_to_debt@FY2024}}, below the peer median of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2024}}.
Customer prepayments: advance ticket cover rose by {{advance_ticket_cover.change@FY2024}} to {{advance_ticket_cover@FY2024}}, a sensitivity if bookings slow.
